people.role: Founder and head of Tầm Kiếm Đường (1162); the Tiêu son turned away from Lê Hoa Am's gate
people.appearance: A lean, sharp-faced man in a hunter's leathers, with a sword whose guard is filed with hundreds of small notches.
people.backstory: Tiêu Vấn Phong grew up on a story. His great-grandfather Tiêu Kiến Quang (tieu_kien_quang), a hunter of Hòe Âm, found a sealed cave on the mountain in 930 with a sword's cold light behind the seal, ran, and never found it again (A108). In 1150 the clan sent its first son, twelve years old, to the gate of Lê Hoa Am (A110). The family said it was for the nuns' learning. He went for the cave. The abbess Thái Lê Tuyết (thai_le_tuyet) looked at him, with the prioress Mạnh Tĩnh Chi (manh_tinh_chi) beside her, and sent him down the mountain for being a boy. He became a hunter and a guide. In 1162, at twenty-four, he founded Tầm Kiếm Đường for the men the hermitage will not take, to search for the sealed sword cave (V069). He learned the sword late, from the guest elder Sài Mộ Kiếm (sai_mo_kiem), and built the hall's canon with him. In thirty-eight years he has searched 412 caves and filed a notch for each in his sword's guard. In the spring of 1199 he asked the lord, Băng Tâm, for the hall's right to cross above the hermitage's gate, and the Hall of Cold Law will hear the suit at Hòe Âm in the autumn.
people.wants: To make the abbess say under oath, before the lord, why the gate is shut to him, whether he wins the mountain or not.
people.secret: He filed the suit because he stopped believing in the cave twenty years ago. He carries a sealed letter that hands the hall to his nephew as a guides' guild, and he means to send it the day the abbess swears the gate shut.

people.role: Guest elder and sword teacher of the hall; the man Tư Không Hạc Niên beat in 1130
people.appearance: A tall, grey, beautifully dressed swordsman gone to seed, who drinks with his left hand so that his right stays steady.
people.backstory: A market son of Tống Khách Thị who was the finest loose sword in the north-east for a century. In 1130 he challenged the wandering sage Tư Không Hạc Niên (tu_khong_hac_nien) in his own market and lost in three passes. The sage handed his sword back and settled in the market to teach no one (A141). Sài left. In 1165 the young Tiêu Vấn Phong (tieu_van_phong) hired him to teach the hall, and he has stayed because the hunters ask better questions than duelists. He wants a second duel before one of them dies.
people.wants: A second duel with Tư Không Hạc Niên before one of them dies.
people.secret: For a year he has sent the sage unsigned insults under Quách Độ Ảnh's (quach_do_anh) name, so that Tư Không comes for the pupil and takes him away from the hall.
people.exception: R2/R3: guest elder (khách khanh), hired to teach; the hall has no lean, so no exception is strictly needed

people.role: Co-founder and chief guide of the hall
people.appearance: A cheerful, bow-legged mountain guide who carries a basket on his back in every season.
people.backstory: A woodcutter's son from Hàn Khê Thôn who hunted with Tiêu Vấn Phong (tieu_van_phong) as boys and founded the hall with him in 1162. He guides caravans and Pavilion envoys over the passes and knows every path on the massif. Thirty years ago he went up to the Gate Hermitage to ask about a cave and was turned away by the grey sister Hướng Thiết Lan (huong_thiet_lan). He goes back every spring with a basket of larch mushrooms, and she takes it. In 1199 he would not swear for the hall's suit against her gate, the first thing he has ever refused his sworn brother.
people.wants: To get Hướng Thiết Lan off the Hall of Cold Law's oath without making her lie.
people.secret: Every spring he builds a hut a little higher in the larches above the gate, where neither the hermitage nor the lodge may go, and Ngưu Phá Sơn (nguu_pha_son) carries the planks up in the mushroom basket.

people.role: A Pavilion outer disciple who failed the Frost Test three times
people.appearance: A stiff, careful man who still sits like a Băng Tâm disciple and hates that he does.
people.backstory: From the ice-hole village of the far north, he sat three solstice nights on the frozen mere of Hàn Giao Chử under Đỗ Sương Nhi (do_suong_nhi) and felt nothing but cold. He refused the Desert Pavilion and the vassals the Pavilion offered him, walked south, and found Tầm Kiếm in 1185. He teaches the outer gate here with the patience the Pavilion taught him. He is angry at it for teaching him that and nothing else.
people.wants: To prove that a Pavilion reject can make a swordsman.
people.secret: Each solstice night he sits his pupils through a Frost Test of his own on the lodge pond and fails whom he likes, so that none can leave him for the Pavilion. Ngô Hàn Đạc (ngo_han_dac) has now failed it twice here too.
